title: metaspec-trust/1
description: The packs whose tool the user trusts: per pack directory (resolved) the digest of the manifest's `tool` section, `sha256:` and the SHA-256 of its JSON. Written by `metaspec trust <dir>` to trust.json in the user's state directory ($XDG_STATE_HOME/metaspec, else ~/.local/state/metaspec).
